# netactuate_ssl_certificate (Resource)

Manages a SSL Certificate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the certificate and its key from files rather than inlining them, so the key does not
# end up in the configuration or in version control.
resource "netactuate_ssl_certificate" "example" {
  name        = "example"
  certificate = file("${path.module}/example.crt")
  private_key = file("${path.module}/example.key")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `certificate` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded certificate
- `name` (String) Name of the SSL certificate
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded private key

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the SSL certificate

### Read-Only

- `domains` (List of String) Domains covered by the certificate
- `expiration` (String) Certificate expiration date
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the certificate is active
- `ssl_certificate_id` (Number) The SSL certificate ID assigned by the API
- `status` (String) Certificate status

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_ssl_certificate.example 12345
```
